evaluation: first-use custom regression for a public historical issue; not a blind holdout or official benchmark
instruction: Fix Click shell completion for option values starting with symbols. For example a -c Choice containing +red and +blue should complete both for incomplete '+' when '+' is not an option prefix for that command. Determine option prefixes from the active context, not from whether a character is punctuation. Preserve option-name precedence for prefixes that are actually registered, including custom + and / options. Count options and boolean flags must not consume a following value-completion slot. Preserve regular choices, multi-value and repeated options, --option=value completion, positional values after --, path completion, and nested-command context behavior. Inspect the repository and implement a compatible fix. Only existing Python files under src/click/ will be exported. No network is available. You may write local tests; do not modify upstream tests. Submit after focused checks pass.
